why: The named, shrink-only record of every check `make verify` is allowed to record as SKIP (rc 2 CANNOT-ASSESS) -- scripts/verify.sh's skip ratchet (issue #1199). A skip is named here or the run is REFUSED by name: the composite will not publish a `verify: PASS` whose skip set is narrated by nobody. Three kinds, all precise: `venue` (the check cannot assess because a NAMED PRECONDITION this venue must supply is not supplied -- honoured only while it is NOT supplied, so it de-activates itself the moment the venue supplies it; a check that still cannot assess WITH its precondition supplied is a defect of the CHECK, #1176, and is refused by name). A venue precondition has exactly TWO measured forms, never an assertion: a repo-relative PATH that must be absent (`vendor/CMR/sync`), and a COMMAND this venue must be able to run (`gh auth status`, supplied only when the command exits 0). The command form is the check's OWN probe quoted verbatim -- scripts/check-skip-ratchet.sh refuses a command that no file under scripts/ runs, so this record cannot invent a precondition nobody measures -- and `standing-gap` (the check's inputs ARE present and it still cannot assess, so it must name the OPEN issue that tracks it and is STALE the moment it assesses -- the entry must then be deleted) and `live-dependent` (the check's ASSESSABILITY is a property of the WORLD, #1410: the entry names the LIVE `mechanism` that did not answer and the OPEN issue that tracks it, is honoured BY NAME while the check cannot assess, is NOT stale when the check assesses -- reported as not biting, never failed -- and is REFUSED when the check FAILS, because a failing check is a FINDING, not a skip. It declares no precondition: a precondition is a named thing THIS VENUE supplies, and this kind's blindness is not this venue's to supply). An entry that matters is matched EXACTLY (check + kind + the declared precondition, or the issue), so it cannot widen to cover a different blindness.

tracking-lease.why: Every entry carries the QUARANTINE's lease -- `tracked_by` plus `tracking {state, measured_at, measured_by, measured_via, max_age_hours}` -- and is honoured ONLY while that block says the tracking issue is OPEN and the measurement is younger than the term (scripts/lib/skip-ratchet.py, issue #1499). The shape is BORROWED, not invented: governance/reconcile/real-tree-quarantine.json plus real_tree_baseline.py's QuarantineLease honour nothing unless state == open and the measurement is inside max_age_hours -- one exemption vocabulary in this repository, not two. A state that is not open, and a measurement older than the term, are each REFUSED by name (rc 1); a MISSING or malformed block is CANNOT-ASSESS (rc 2), because a declaration that cannot be read is never read as still excused. The lease is checked on EVERY entry, not only on the ones that skipped: on a developer box these entries do not bite at all (gh, docker and crontab are present), so a lease inspected only where a skip happened would never have looked at the 13 whose trackers had closed -- which is exactly how the defect this field exists for stayed invisible.

This block is LOAD-BEARING, not decorative: scripts/check-skip-ratchet.sh asserts that every row names a committed entry, that the row's `now` is that entry's `tracked_by`, and that `now` differs from `was` -- so the decision cannot silently drift away from the entries it describes.

entries.reason: kind: live-dependent -- #1410, moved off `venue` (#1394). This check reads the LIVE GitHub protection, and it drives scripts/check-gate-status.sh's producer probe, whose LIVE half needs `gh` too. With `gh` supplied it assesses (measured: rc 0 on a box). With no `gh` at all it cannot, and where `gh` answers and the API read does not -- `gh-unauthenticated` / `gh-repo-unresolvable` / `gh-statuses-unreadable` -- it answers rc 2 NAMING THE SOURCE, exactly as its honesty contract requires. That last case is a property of the WORLD and not a defect of the check, which is what this kind says: honoured BY NAME while the mechanism cannot answer, NOT stale when the check assesses, and REFUSED the moment the check FAILS (rc 1), because a failing check is a finding, not a skip. It was a `standing-gap` because the producer probe could never assess, then a `venue` entry carrying the precondition `gh auth status`; that kind's refusal told the operator to repair a check that was behaving correctly whenever `gh` was present and the API still silent, which is the mislabel #1410 removes. It names the VENUE gap: its blindness in the Cloud Build container is that the venue supplies no `gh` at all, which is #1295 (the issue #1361 was superseded by on 2026-09-19). It was never waiting on a producer to exist -- #1382, the tracker it used to name, closed 2026-09-19T15:50:08Z and tracked the gate-status producer instead.

entries.reason: kind: live-dependent -- #1410, moved off `venue` (#1394). The producing question is answered in two halves. The TREE half (is a producer REACHED from the path that makes the PR verdict?) needs nothing of the venue, is provable offline, and is unchanged. The LIVE half is READ with `gh` -- the commit under test's statuses, then the most recent default-branch commits -- because the ONLY field the tree carries about liveness is infra/cloudbuild/verify-trigger.yaml's `disabled:`, and this repository PINS that `true` by policy (scripts/check-cloudbuild.sh requires "must ship disabled: true (GR-5)"), so a probe that reads it as live state names a condition the tree can never falsify. Measured 2026-09-19: the probe answered `CANNOT-ASSESS REQUIRED-BUT-GATED-OFF` (rc 2) while the live trigger is ENABLED and `ao/gate-of-record` is posted (2adbe48b, 83ff32db, 0dbb0e68). In a venue without a working `gh` the check therefore cannot assess -- that is a VENUE gap, named by the check's own probe, and this entry de-activates itself the moment the venue supplies `gh`. With `gh` supplied the check assesses: rc 0 when the context is observed producing, rc 1 BY NAME when the source WAS read and nothing is producing (a finding about the repository, not an inability to assess -- so not a skip). NOT a `standing-gap` (that kind goes STALE the moment the check assesses) and NOT a `venue` entry (#1410): supplying `gh` is not what this check needs, the commit-statuses SOURCE must answer. The residual #1394 measured is exactly why the move was needed: with `gh auth status` succeeding but the repository/API reads failing, the check answers rc 2 naming the source, and the `venue` kind then refused the entry with 'this is a defect of the check, not of the venue (#1176)' -- a red that was RIGHT (the required context's liveness genuinely cannot be established) carrying a SECOND REASON that was WRONG, telling the operator to repair a check that was behaving correctly. As `live-dependent` the entry is honoured BY NAME while the mechanism cannot answer, is NOT stale when the check assesses, and is REFUSED if the check FAILS (rc 1), because a failing check is a finding, not a skip.

why-these-entries-exist: The list holds ONLY the gaps of the CLOUD BUILD venue (#1361) and no local one, and that is a measurement, not an omission. In the two venues a DEVELOPER produces, nothing skips: (a) a FRESH WORKTREE (`git worktree add` of this repo) was run end to end -- 202 checks rc 0, 1 check rc 1 (an unrelated `reconcile` real-tree drift baseline), 0 checks rc 2, verdict `verify: FAIL (1 of 203 checks failed)` with NO `skipped:` clause at all; (b) the populated checkout of the same commit. A skip that appears on the developer box is therefore a FINDING, not a known limit, and the ratchet refuses it by name with the remedy printed beside it -- which is the property this issue asked for: a skip bucket that cannot be permanently populated. Every entry that IS in this record is one of the required check's runner's own gaps: `control-plane-verify (purebliss-ghl)` runs `make verify` inside a bare `python:3.14` container with no `gh`, no docker (so no compose v2 plugin), no `crontab`, and no network with which to initialise `vendor/CMR`, so those twelve checks answer rc 2 there on EVERY run. That is filed as #1361 -- which is now CLOSED (2026-09-19T01:03:11Z, superseded by #1295) -- so each entry names the live successor #1295 instead, and the lease below REFUSES an entry whose tracked_by is not open (see tracking-repoint-2026-09-20); supplying the tool or repairing the check deletes the entry, and a stale entry fails the run by name. Each of them is an `unused_venue_entry` on every local run -- a NOTE, never a failure -- and bites only in the venue whose precondition is genuinely absent.

Two of those entries carry the THIRD kind, `live-dependent` (#1410), and they are there because neither older kind can say what is true of them: as `venue` entries they were honoured only while their declared precondition (`gh auth status`) was NOT supplied, so the moment `gh` answered and the repository/API read still failed, the ratchet refused them as a defect of the CHECK rather than of the venue (#1176) -- the red was right and the REASON was wrong, telling the operator to repair a check that was behaving correctly. An authenticated-but-unreadable source is a property of the WORLD, so these two name the LIVE mechanism they depend on in `mechanism`, are honoured BY NAME while it cannot answer, do NOT go stale when the check assesses (reported as not biting -- on a developer box with a working `gh` both assess, rc 0), and are REFUSED the moment the check FAILS (rc 1), because a failing check is a FINDING, not a skip. The shrink-only property is kept, and it is what caught these two: each names the OPEN issue that tracks the mechanism, and BOTH of the trackers they named have since closed -- #1382 closed 2026-09-19T15:50:08Z, which is why they now name the live trackers #1504 (the statuses source the gate-status check reads) and #1295 (the venue that supplies no gh, which is branch-protection's blindness).

The two checks that used to occupy the bucket are NOT here because they were REPAIRED, not because they were excused: `dispatch-queue` (#1189) and `paperclip-routines` (#1176) both reach real verdicts (measured at origin/master a60ab88: rc 0 each, 9 and 11 controls provoked). Naming them would be the fiction this ratchet exists to prevent.

The `venue` KIND is not hypothetical and was measured too: in a tree carrying no local submodule objects (so `git submodule update --init vendor/CMR` cannot succeed offline), `module-registry`, `diagrams-declaration` and `codeidx-surface` each answer rc 2 -- `the pinned hub catalog is absent` / `vendored contract unreadable` / `vendored mandatory seed unreadable` -- exactly as each check's own header declares. A lane in that venue names them with the precondition path it is missing, or supplies the submodule; it does not get a silent PASS.

Growing this list is a deliberate act naming the PRECONDITION the venue lacks -- a repo-relative PATH, or a COMMAND the venue must be able to run -- together with the OPEN issue that tracks supplying it (#1295 for the Cloud Build container, which superseded #1361 on 2026-09-19; a closed tracker is now REFUSED by name); shrinking it is automatic -- an entry whose check assesses FAILS the run until the entry is deleted.
